# DOMPurify

`purify.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of DOMPurify **3.4.17**.
It is served locally so the exercise manager needs no package installation or CDN access.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify>
- Distribution: <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cure53/DOMPurify/3.4.17/dist/purify.min.js>
- License: [Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0](DOMPurify-LICENSE), copied from the same tag.
- SHA-256: `cd37898f9782adf54820c413191b5691803f0f137c799d6edcfd38523b4c2c31`

When updating, use an upstream release tag, copy its distribution and license without modifying them, update this version and checksum, and run the renderer/browser regression tests. Follow upstream security releases: <https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/security/advisories>.
